basics.name: Luca Piccinini
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience building fintech, crypto and high-demand transactional systems. Specialized in Python, Django, FastAPI, TypeScript and NestJS, focused on scalable APIs, microservices, distributed systems and event-driven architectures. Experienced taking ownership of critical features end to end, from problem analysis and technical design to implementation, production rollout, monitoring and evolution. I focus on building clean, maintainable software with real business impact, prioritizing simple, robust and scalable solutions. I regularly work with AWS, RabbitMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker and Kubernetes. I also build web and mobile applications with React and React Native, and use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex to accelerate debugging, refactors, test generation, technical research and delivery.

work.name: Ripio
work.summary: Designed, developed and evolved fintech and crypto products using Python, Django, FastAPI, Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, React and React Native. Built backend services, distributed systems, event-driven architectures and cloud-native applications supporting critical operations, including wallets, transactions, balances, limits, referrals and real-time communication.
highlights: Led the architecture and development of the Profit and Loss (P&L) product for B2C clients, using asynchronous processing and backend-driven conditional rendering

Unified user balances from different company products into a single source of truth through event-driven asynchronous processing. This removed direct queries to multiple balance microservices and reduced read latency by approximately 80%

Consolidated operations from multiple services into a unified backend layer, improving traceability for internal teams, data consistency and the user experience through an integrated movement view. This reduced backend request load by approximately 30% and improved query latency by up to 80% by serving preprocessed data

Redesigned limit logic from different services into a single backend, processing user movements asynchronously and keeping limits updated in near real time. This reduced latency for limit-related queries by approximately 80%

Implemented a WebSocket service for real-time client communication, allowing users to view movements, balances and relevant events without manual refresh. This reduced unnecessary app refresh requests by approximately 70%
Drove the adoption of Clean Architecture and SOLID principles in backend services, improving maintainability, testability and responsibility boundaries in distributed systems

Contributed to the CX workflow by integrating third-party services for customer support, reducing agent response time by approximately 50%, improving support quality and enabling user interaction auditing
Used AI tools such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex to accelerate technical research, debugging, refactors and test generation while keeping critical review over final decisions
